verdict.rationale: LM Studio's docs describe an OpenAI-like REST API for serving local models (lm-studio-docs-5, lm-studio-docs-9), and OpenAI-compatible chat completion APIs conventionally support token streaming, which community users confirm makes it 'really easy to spin up a server and test' (lm-studio-comm-7). However, no evidence explicitly confirms or demonstrates streaming token output, so this is an inference from API compatibility rather than a directly verified capability.
